scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild lambda/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/lambda.cjs
scripts.clean: node -e "try { fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.unlinkSync('server.js'); } catch (e) {}"
